reviews.shade: Fillimilli S Fitting Flat Foundation Brush 826 (Renewal)
reviews.text: This brush is cool, What I like about this brush is that it has long bristles, which helps prevent foundation from getting stuck in creases. I also like that it comes with a plastic case to prevent it from getting dirty in my makeup bag.
reviews.zh: 呢款刷子幾好，我鍾意佢嘅刷毛長，有助防止粉底卡喺細紋入面。我亦鍾意佢附有膠盒，可以防止刷子喺化妝袋入面弄髒。

reviews.shade: Fillimilli S Fitting Flat Foundation Brush 826
reviews.text: This brush is good for applying thin layer bases. It can caused streaks if there's too little or too much foundation on it so it requires some technique. Overall it is good for applying thin layers of foundation.
reviews.zh: 呢款刷子適合塗薄薄一層底妝。如果刷子上粉底太少或者太多，都會產生條紋，所以需要一啲技巧。整體嚟講，佢啱塗薄層粉底。

reviews.shade: Fillimilli S Fitting Flat Foundation Brush 826
reviews.text: super good at getting that thin even layer of foundation onto your skin for even coverage, use this to apply onto your face and then use a foundation puff to blend and you will get amazing coverage and a gorgeous finish!
reviews.zh: 非常擅長將薄而均勻嘅粉底塗喺皮膚上，達到均勻遮蓋。先用呢款刷子塗喺面上，再用粉撲推勻，就會有超好嘅遮蓋力同靚妝效果！

reviews.text: This is super nice and convenient to have. This was my final one to complete the entire fillimilli s line brush collection. Bristles are soft but be careful with application because it could leave somewhat of a patch/“lift” the area. I recommended dabbing some on the back of your hand and then dipping a bit of the brush before applying it to the targeted area.
reviews.zh: 非常好用，都好方便。呢支係我最後一支，完成咗成套 fillimilli s 系列刷具。刷毛好軟，但塗抹時要小心，因為可能會令局部位置有少少厚塊／「浮起」。我建議先喺手背塗少少，再沾一點刷子，然後先塗喺目標位置。

reviews.shade: Fillimilli S Fitting Flat Foundation Brush 826
reviews.text: The brush is soft and applies foundation in a smooth, thin layer. It makes spreading foundation on my face much easier and is more convenient to use than a spatula. I love that it comes with a case, so any leftover product on the brush doesn’t smear inside my makeup bag or any makeup. It’s also easy to carry around with the case, which protects the brush
reviews.zh: 刷子好軟，可以將粉底均勻咁塗成薄薄一層。比起用刮刀，塗喺面上容易好多，用起嚟都方便啲。我鍾意附有盒子，刷子上殘留嘅產品唔會喺化妝袋或者其他化妝品上弄污。攜帶時有盒子保護刷子，都好方便。

reviews.shade: Fillimilli S Fitting Flat Foundation Brush 826
reviews.text: it’s really good, I didn’t have much expectations but actually it works really great! and it’s so good for foundation, it helps to create a thin layer, but you really have to be careful with the amount of foundation!
reviews.zh: 真係好好，本來冇咩期望，但係實際用落效果好好！用嚟上粉底好好，有助形成薄薄一層，不過真係要小心粉底嘅份量！

reviews.shade: Fillimilli S Fitting Flat Foundation Brush 826
reviews.text: Wow! The way this seamlessly glides foundation or BB cream onto my face is insane! I use it to apply thin layers and then blend with a puff. I can see why this sold out! You literally cannot mess up your makeup with this brush, it is so good! If you're looking for a very thin applicator brush, this is it!
reviews.zh: 哇！佢將粉底或者 BB 霜無縫咁推喺面上嘅效果真係好神！我用佢塗薄薄一層，然後用粉撲推開。我明點解佢會售罄！真係一定唔會搞砸妝容，超級好用！如果你想搵一支好薄嘅上妝刷，就係呢支啦！

reviews.shade: Fillimilli S Fitting Flat Foundation Brush 826
reviews.text:
リキッドファンデ用にスパチュラと同時購入。私は厚塗りすると毛穴が目立ってしまうので、スパチュラの方が仕上がりが綺麗でした。毎回洗って衛生的に使えるのもあって、スパチュラしか使ってません。
しっかりメイクする分にはきっと良いんでしょう。
reviews.zh:
同時買咗刮刀，用嚟搽液體粉底。我如果厚塗，毛孔會好明顯，所以用刮刀嘅效果比較靚。每次可以洗咗再用，好衛生，所以我而家淨係用刮刀。
如果係要化好濃嘅妝，我諗佢應該都幾好用。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
